verses.pali: “Pañcime, bhikkhave, appaṁ rattiyā supanti, bahuṁ jagganti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these five sleep little at night, staying mostly awake.

verses.pali: Itthī, bhikkhave, purisādhippāyā appaṁ rattiyā supati, bahuṁ jaggati.
verses.english: A woman longing for a man.

verses.pali: Puriso, bhikkhave, itthādhippāyo appaṁ rattiyā supati, bahuṁ jaggati.
verses.english: A man longing for a woman.

verses.pali: Coro, bhikkhave, ādānādhippāyo appaṁ rattiyā supati, bahuṁ jaggati.
verses.english: A thief longing for their loot.

verses.pali: Rājā, bhikkhave, rājakaraṇīyesu yutto appaṁ rattiyā supati, bahuṁ jaggati.
verses.english: A king busy with his duties.

verses.pali: Bhikkhu, bhikkhave, visaṁyogādhippāyo appaṁ rattiyā supati, bahuṁ jaggati.
verses.english: A mendicant longing for freedom from the yoke.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca appaṁ rattiyā supanti, bahuṁ jaggantī”ti.
verses.english: These five sleep little at night, staying mostly awake.”
